description: Extract a page range into one PDF, or split into single pages or chunks of N. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused. Returns PDF base64 and a ZIP when there are several files.

data.description: PDF bytes as base64 or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB. Provide data or url.

range.description: Pages to keep, such as 1-3,5. Blank keeps every page.

url.description: Public URL of a PDF. Private and local addresses are refused. Provide data or url.

name: split_pdf

zip.description: ZIP of the PDFs when there is more than one, otherwise null.

title: Split a PDF
